#Preparing Data
```{r}
# Katia Del-Rio Tsonis Lab transcriptome annotations
annotations <- read.csv("Nvir_Annotations/Nvir Latest Annotation Katia/Nvir_annotations_MT_Katia_final.csv", header = TRUE)

# Takes the annotation of isoforms with the most GO annotations, one row per gene
annotations_gid <- annotations

annotations_gid$X.GO_IP[is.na(annotations_gid$X.GO_IP)] <- 0

setDT(annotations_gid)
annotations_gid <- annotations_gid[, .SD[which.max(X.GO_IP)], by = GENEID] # Dplyr takes too long, this is more efficient
```


```{r}
# Read in salmon abundance files and the sample metadata
dir <- "salmon_MT_Katia_reference"

coldata <- read.table(file.path(dir, "samples.txt"), header = TRUE)

coldata <- coldata %>%
  mutate(timepoint = relevel(factor(timepoint), ref = "120"), # Dediff as the interesting one
         differentiation = factor(differentiation))

rownames(coldata) <- coldata$replicate

files <- file.path(dir, coldata$filename) # List of all of your files
names(files) <- coldata$replicate # Name files based on metadata

tx2gene <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "tx2gene_nvir_katia.csv"))

txi <- tximport(files,
                type = "salmon",
                tx2gene = tx2gene)
```


#Differential Expression Analysis
```{r}
# DESeq2 with 120h as the base: 128h vs 120h (early dedifferentiation, the main comparison) and 168h vs 120h
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                colData = coldata,
                                design = ~ timepoint)

# Pre-filter -> at least 10 counts in 3 samples. N = minimal number of samples where non-zero counts would be considered interesting
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep,]

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "timepoint_128_vs_120", type = "apeglm") # Shrink inflated LFC for genes with low expression
res3 <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "timepoint_168_vs_120", type = "apeglm")

dds$timepoint <- factor(dds$timepoint, levels = c(0, 8, 72, 120, 128, 144, 168)) # Re-level factors back for plots

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Same model with 0h as the base: 120h vs 0h (differentiation)
coldata2 <- coldata %>%
  mutate(timepoint = relevel(factor(timepoint), ref = "0"))

dds2 <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                 colData = coldata2,
                                 design = ~ timepoint)

keep2 <- rowSums(counts(dds2) >= 10) >= 3 # Same pre-filter
dds2 <- dds2[keep2,]

dds2 <- DESeq(dds2)

res2 <- lfcShrink(dds2, coef = "timepoint_120_vs_0", type = "apeglm")

dds2$timepoint <- factor(dds2$timepoint, levels = c(0, 8, 72, 120, 128, 144, 168)) # Re-level factors as for dds (vst depends slightly on it)

vsd2 <- vst(dds2, blind = FALSE) # For the muscle heatmap
```


```{r}
# Annotated results with the most significant genes on top: 128h vs 120h (res_df), 120h vs 0h (res_df2), 168h vs 120h (res_df3)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "GENEID") %>%
  left_join(annotations_gid, by = "GENEID") %>%
  relocate(SYMBOL, .before = 1) %>%
  arrange(padj)

res_df2 <- as.data.frame(res2) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "GENEID") %>%
  left_join(annotations_gid, by = "GENEID") %>%
  relocate(SYMBOL, .before = 1) %>%
  arrange(padj)

res_df3 <- as.data.frame(res3) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "GENEID") %>%
  left_join(annotations_gid, by = "GENEID") %>%
  relocate(SYMBOL, .before = 1) %>%
  arrange(padj)
```


```{r}
# Only GO annotated results for GO ORA, removing probable unmerged isoforms to avoid redundancy for volcano and heatmaps
res_anno <- res_df %>%
  filter(annotation_status == "TRUE") %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = replace(SYMBOL, SYMBOL == "HIF3A.1", "HIF3A"))

# Keep the most significant hit for likely unmerged isoforms, to avoid redundancy for the top 20 heatmap
res_anno_single <- res_anno %>%
  group_by(Uniprot_SP) %>%  # Group by Swissprot names
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 1) %>%  # Keep the most significant hit
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Significant genes for clustering and the volcano caption. After review, 0.001 is a good balance for clustering
sig_genes <- res_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.001)

sig_genes_anno <- res_anno %>%
  filter(padj < 0.001)
```


#Functions
```{r}
# GENEID of each SYMBOL (or GENEID) in genes; a SYMBOL shared by several genes gives the most significant one (res_df is sorted by padj)
convert_list <- function(genes) {

  converted_genes <- sapply(genes, function(gene_name) {
    res_df$GENEID[which(res_df$SYMBOL == gene_name | res_df$GENEID == gene_name)][1]
  })

  return(converted_genes[!is.na(converted_genes)]) # Genes without a match are dropped
}
```


```{r}
# Gene plot: log2 normalised counts over the time course. The caption has one line with padj and LFC per comparison in contrasts:
# "120v0" (res_df2), "128v120" (res_df) or "168v120" (res_df3). Text sizes in pt, for panels saved at their size in the figure
plotGene <- function(gene_name, title = NULL, contrasts = c("120v0", "168v120")) {

  dds$timepoint <- as.numeric(as.character(dds$timepoint))

  gene <- convert_list(gene_name)

  gene_symbol <- res_df %>%
    filter(GENEID == gene) %>%
    pull(SYMBOL)

  dat <- plotCounts(dds, gene, intgroup = c("timepoint", "differentiation"), returnData = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(logcount = log2(count + 1))

  mean_logcount <- dat %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_logcount = mean(logcount))

  # "padj = ...; LFC = ..." for this gene in one results table
  stats <- function(res_table) {
    row <- res_table %>%
      filter(GENEID == gene)

    padj_value <- row$padj[1]

    formatted_padj <- ifelse(padj_value < 0.05,
                             ifelse(padj_value < 1e-6,
                                    format(padj_value, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE),
                                    round(padj_value, 6)),
                             paste("ns", round(padj_value, 4)))

    paste0("padj = ", formatted_padj, "; LFC = ", round(row$log2FoldChange[1], 2))
  }

  tables <- list("120v0" = res_df2, "128v120" = res_df, "168v120" = res_df3)
  names_h <- c("120v0" = "120h vs 0h", "128v120" = "128h vs 120h", "168v120" = "168h vs 120h")

  caption <- paste(sapply(contrasts, function(k) paste0(names_h[k], ": ", stats(tables[[k]]))), collapse = "\n")

  ggplot(dat, aes(timepoint, logcount)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = differentiation), size = 0.7) +
    geom_line(data = mean_logcount, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_logcount, group = 1), color = "#FF7F00", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) + # Vertical line at x=120 dediff
    labs(
      title = if (!is.null(title)) title else gene_symbol,
      x = "Timepoint (hours)",
      y = "Log2 expression count",
      color = "Differentiation",
      caption = caption
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 168, by = 24)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("diff" = "#68E807", "dediff" = "#7E10D1")) +
    theme_minimal(base_line_size = 0.25) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "darkblue", size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25)
    )
}
```


```{r}
# Column annotation (diff / dediff) of the heatmaps
heat_anno <- data.frame(Differentiation = vsd$differentiation, row.names = colnames(vsd))

heat_colors <- list(
    Differentiation = c("diff" = "#68E807", "dediff" = "#7E10D1"))
```


```{r}
# Heatmap of vst values (scaled per row) for SYMBOLs or GENEIDs, with significance stars (padj, 128h vs 120h) on the row names.
# key = TRUE adds the diff / dediff legend and the annotation name; the figures have their own key
plotHeat <- function(gene_input, title, cuts = NA, cellwidth = 20, cellheight = 30,
                     fontsize = 18, fontsize_row = 18, fontsize_col = 18, key = FALSE) {

  GENEID <- convert_list(gene_input)

  gene_symbol <- res_df$SYMBOL[match(GENEID, res_df$GENEID)]

  # Significance stars for one gene
  get_stars <- function(gene) {
    padj <- res_df[res_df$GENEID == gene, "padj"]
    if (is.na(padj) || padj >= 0.05) return("")
    if (padj < 0.001) return("***")
    if (padj < 0.01) return("**")
    return("*")
  }

  pheatmap(assay(vsd[GENEID,]),
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           annotation_col = heat_anno,
           annotation_colors = heat_colors,
           annotation_legend = key,
           annotation_names_col = key,
           labels_row = paste0(gene_symbol, sapply(GENEID, get_stars)),
           labels_col = coldata$timepoint,
           scale = "row",
           fontsize = fontsize,
           fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
           fontsize_col = fontsize_col,
           main = title,
           cellwidth = cellwidth,
           cellheight = cellheight,
           cutree_rows = cuts,
           gaps_col = 12) # Break after the 12th column, after Dediff induction
}
```


```{r}
# Gene set plot: mean Z-score (vst values centred and scaled per gene) over the time course of the expressed genes of a GO term
plotSet <- function(GO_ID, set_name) {

  set_genes <- bitr(GO_ID,
                    fromType = "GOALL", # The common ID.
                    toType = "SYMBOL", # The ID you want.
                    OrgDb = "org.Nviridescens.eg.db") %>%
    dplyr::select(SYMBOL) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pull(SYMBOL) %>%
    convert_list()

  set_genes <- res_df %>%
    filter(GENEID %in% set_genes) %>%
    arrange(padj)

  gene_set <- assay(vsd)[convert_list(set_genes$SYMBOL), ]

  # Center the data by subtracting the row means, then scale by dividing over sd per row
  gene_set <- gene_set - rowMeans(gene_set)
  gene_set <- gene_set / matrixStats::rowSds(gene_set)

  # Join with the sample meta data in a long format
  coldata_df <- as.data.frame(coldata) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

  gene_set <- gene_set %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "SYMBOL") %>%
    pivot_longer(!SYMBOL, names_to = "sample", values_to = "counts") %>%
    left_join(coldata_df, by = "sample")

  # Mean Z-score at each time point
  gene_set_means <- gene_set %>%
    group_by(timepoint) %>%
    summarize(mean_exp = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE))

  gene_set_means$timepoint <- as.numeric(as.character(gene_set_means$timepoint))

  ggplot(gene_set_means, aes(timepoint, mean_exp)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2, color = "dodgerblue") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) + # y=0 line
    geom_vline(xintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) + # Vertical line at x=120 dediff
    labs(
      x = "Timepoint (hours)",
      y = paste0("Z-score (n=", length(unique(gene_set$SYMBOL)), ")"),
      title = set_name
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # White background for panels.
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), # Increase the size of x-axis labels
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 24), # Increase the size of y-axis labels
      title = element_text(size = 20)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 168, by = 24))
}
```

#Clustering
```{r}
# Z-scores of the significant genes (128h vs 120h) over the time course: vst values centred and scaled per gene
mat2clust <- assay(vsd)[sig_genes$GENEID, ]

mat2clust <- mat2clust - rowMeans(mat2clust)
mat2clust <- mat2clust / matrixStats::rowSds(mat2clust)

# K-means with 8 clusters, the optimal number in an elbow plot. MUST SET SEED, stochastic method!!!
set.seed(123)

nclust <- 8
kclusters <- kmeans(mat2clust, centers = nclust, nstart = 20)$cluster

cluster_sizes <- table(kclusters) # For the legend
```


```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3C: mean Z-score of each cluster over the time course
clusters_df <- data.frame(GENEID = names(kclusters),
                          cluster = as.factor(kclusters))

coldata_df <- coldata %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(as.character(timepoint)))

# Join with the sample meta data and the clusters in a long format
mat_long <- mat2clust %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "GENEID") %>%
  pivot_longer(!GENEID, names_to = "sample", values_to = "counts") %>%
  left_join(coldata_df, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(clusters_df, by = "GENEID")

# Cluster means at each time point, with the cluster size in the label
cluster_means <- mat_long %>%
  group_by(cluster, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(mean_exp = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = paste0(cluster, " (n=", cluster_sizes[as.character(cluster)], ")"))

cluster_means$cluster_label <- factor(cluster_means$cluster_label, # Cluster order (10 goes after 1 otherwise)
                                      levels = paste0(1:nclust, " (n=", cluster_sizes[as.character(1:nclust)], ")"))

cluster_plot <- ggplot(cluster_means, aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_exp, group = cluster_label, color = cluster_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) + # y=0 line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) + # Vertical line at x=120 dediff
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Cluster") + # Legend colors and title
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint (hours)",
    y = "Z-score",
    title = "K-means Clustering of Significant Genes\n(128h vs 120h)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_line_size = 0.25, base_rect_size = 0.25) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # White background for panels.
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"), # Facet labels
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)
  )  +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 72, 144)) + # Sampled timepoints, more labels crowd at this size
  facet_wrap(~cluster, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x")

# Sizes in pt are those of the panel in the figure (75.7 x 138.8 mm)
ggsave(filename = "Myotubes Single Clusters 0.001_v2.png", plot = cluster_plot, width = 75.7, height = 138.8, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```


#GO Enrichment of the Clusters
```{r}
# Gene SYMBOLs of each cluster
genes_clusters <- list()

for (i in 1:nclust) {
  genes_clusters[[paste0("Cluster_", i)]] <- res_df %>%
    filter(GENEID %in% names(kclusters[kclusters == i])) %>%
    arrange(desc(padj)) %>%
    pull(SYMBOL)
}

# Comparing clusters to each other. GO BP, with all GO annotated genes of the experiment as the background
cgo <- compareCluster(geneCluster = genes_clusters,
                      fun = enrichGO,
                      universe = res_anno$SYMBOL,
                      OrgDb = "org.Nviridescens.eg.db",
                      keyType = "SYMBOL",
                      readable = TRUE,
                      ont = "BP",
                      minGSSize = 10,
                      maxGSSize = 500,
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

cgo_simple <- clusterProfiler::simplify(x = cgo, cutoff = 0.7) # Remove redundant GO terms
```



```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3B: cnetplot of the top 3 (simplified) terms per cluster in the cluster colours of Supp. Fig. 3C, with at most 5 genes
# per term (smallest padj at 128h vs 120h); the pie sizes still count all genes of the term. Sizes in pt are those of the panel (101.8 x 99.4 mm)
padj_sym <- tapply(res_df$padj, res_df$SYMBOL, min)

cgo_top <- cgo_simple
cgo_top@compareClusterResult$geneID <- sapply(strsplit(cgo_top@compareClusterResult$geneID, "/"),
                                              function(g) paste(head(g[order(padj_sym[g])], 5), collapse = "/"))

set.seed(1) # Network layout
cnet <- cnetplot(cgo_top, showCategory = 3, layout = igraph::layout_with_fr, node_label = "category",
                 size_category = 3, size_item = 1, color_edge = "grey85", size_edge = 0.15)

# Edges and pies only: drop the node points, the default labels and the pie size legend scatterpie adds (layers with <= 12 rows)
cnet$layers <- Filter(function(l) inherits(l$geom, c("GeomSegment", "GeomArcBar")) && !(is.data.frame(l$data) && nrow(l$data) <= 12),
                      cnet$layers)

# Pie area instead of radius proportional to the number of genes, so the large cell cycle terms do not hide the others.
# The radii are in the data of the pie layer, which can only be replaced as a whole
pie <- which(sapply(cnet$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomArcBar")))
pie_data <- cnet$layers[[pie]]$data
pie_data$pathway_size[pie_data$.isCategory] <- 0.5 * sqrt(pie_data$pathway_size[pie_data$.isCategory])
cnet$layers[[pie]]$data <- pie_data

pie_r <- setNames(pie_data$pathway_size, pie_data$label)

# Terms (bold) and genes in one label layer, so they keep clear of each other; point.size keeps them off the pies too
cnet_cgo <- cnet +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set1"), paste0("Cluster_", 1:8)), name = "Cluster",
                    labels = function(b) sub("Cluster_", "", b)) +
  ggtangle::geom_cnet_label(aes(label = ifelse(.data$.isCategory, stringr::str_wrap(.data$label, 18), .data$label),
                                fontface = ifelse(.data$.isCategory, "bold", "plain"),
                                size = ifelse(.data$.isCategory, 5.5, 5) / .pt,
                                point.size = ifelse(.data$.isCategory, 20 * pie_r[.data$label], 1)),
                            node_label = "all", lineheight = 0.85, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0.2,
                            segment.size = 0.1, segment.colour = "grey60", box.padding = 0.12, point.padding = 0,
                            force = 12, force_pull = 0.2, max.iter = 20000, max.time = Inf, seed = 3) +
  scale_size_identity() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5, face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"), legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

ggsave(filename = "Cnetplot 0.001 Myotubes 8h Dediff GO BP.png", plot = cnet_cgo, width = 101.84, height = 99.43, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

#SMADs
```{r}
# Fig. 4E: Z-scores of SMAD1 (BMP) and SMAD3 (TGFbeta) over the time course
smads <- res_df %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% c("SMAD1", "SMAD3")) %>%
  arrange(padj)

smads <- assay(vsd)[convert_list(smads$SYMBOL), ]

# Center the data by subtracting the row means, then scale by dividing over sd per row
smads <- smads - rowMeans(smads)
smads <- smads / matrixStats::rowSds(smads)

# Join with the sample meta data in a long format
coldata_df <- as.data.frame(coldata) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

smads <- smads %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "SYMBOL") %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = case_when(
    SYMBOL == "g.382618" ~ "SMAD3",
    SYMBOL == "g.320517" ~ "SMAD1",
    TRUE ~ SYMBOL
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(!SYMBOL, names_to = "sample", values_to = "counts") %>%
  left_join(coldata_df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(as.character(timepoint)))

# Mean Z-score of each SMAD at each time point
smad_means <- smads %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(mean_exp = mean(counts, na.rm = TRUE))

smads_plot <- ggplot(smads, aes(timepoint, counts, color = SYMBOL)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = smad_means,
            aes(x = timepoint, y = mean_exp, color = SYMBOL),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint (hours)",
    y = "Z-score",
    color = NULL, # No legend title
    title = "SMADs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_line_size = 0.25, base_rect_size = 0.25) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 168, by = 24))

# Sizes in pt are those of the panel in the figure
ggsave(filename = "Overlapping SMAD1 SMAD3_v2.png", plot = smads_plot, width = 94.6, height = 37.8, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
